name: 20-40 percent probability band underconfidence
description: Silent Edge selections in the 20-40% predicted-probability range appear to win more often than the model's own average predicted probability in that range, over the live 2026-09-05..18 window -- a real calibration gap distinct from the already-known RL-012 overconfidence finding at higher (40%+) bands.
rule_definition: Among paired observations with se_probability in [0.20, 0.40), actual_win_rate exceeds avg_predicted_probability by a real positive margin (calibration_error > 0), with a Wilson 95% CI that does not comfortably straddle zero.
